title: Patch test: an exact P1 solution is reproduced to round-off (consistency of every stabilization term, variable viscosity, time term)
physics: P1-representable exact solution of Stokes / Oseen / Navier-Stokes (steady and BDF1/BDF2) with variable mu on distorted and strongly graded meshes: residual-based GLS terms vanish on the exact solution only if R_m is exactly the strong residual (body force, convection, time derivative, grad p, grad mu terms)

parameters.formulation: Equal-order continuous P1/P1 (u, p) on affine triangles, nodal basis, constant density rho, viscosity mu(x) (analytic with gradient, or a P1 nodal field with its element-wise gradient). Residual R_u,a = sum_K int [ rho (u_t + (w.grad)u).N_a e_i + a_visc(mu;u)(N_a e_i) - p d_i N_a - f_i N_a + tau_supg rho ((w.grad N_a) R_i) + tau_c rho (div u) d_i N_a ], R_p,a = sum_K int [ (div u) N_a + (tau_pspg/rho) grad N_a. R ] with the strong residual R = rho (u_t + (w.grad)u) + grad p - div sigma_visc(u; mu) - f (second derivatives of a P1 u vanish; grad mu KEPT: lap: sum_j d_j mu d_j u_i, sym: sum_j d_j mu (d_j u_i + d_i u_j)), w = u (Navier-Stokes), a given field (Oseen) or 0 (Stokes: convective and SUPG terms absent); a_visc lap = mu grad u : grad v, sym = mu (grad u + grad u^T) : grad v; BDF1 u_t = (u - u^{n-1})/dt or BDF2 (3u - 4u^{n-1} + u^{n-2})/(2 dt), constant step; tau_supg = [ (2/dt)^2 + CG w.G w + C_I (mu/rho)^2 G:G ]^(-1/2), tau_pspg = [ CG w.G w + C_I (mu/rho)^2 G:G ]^(-1/2) (NO dt term), tau_c = 1/(tau_pspg tr G), G_ij = sum_k dz_k/dx_i dz_k/dx_j with z the coordinates of the EQUILATERAL reference triangle of edge 1 (invariant under vertex renumbering), C_I = 36, CG = 1 (the (2/dt)^2 term only when dt is given). Every element integral by the pinned 6-point degree-4 rule f5_gls_check.rule_points() (the Galerkin terms of P1 data are polynomials of degree <= 3; tau is not polynomial). The continuity row carries the POSITIVE sign (div u) q. The Newton Jacobian is the exact derivative of this residual INCLUDING d tau / d state. Reference implementation: f5_gls_check.residual (numpy), agreeing with the independent NGSolve assembly to 3e-16.

stabilization.tau: Shakib-type, from the element metric tensor G (docs/guides/fluids.md, stabilized equal-order elements)

nonlinear_solver.start: Stokes solution (GLS-stabilized, w = 0) with the Dirichlet data, then Newton with the exact Jacobian (d tau included) and an Armijo backtracking line search on the dual-norm merit (sufficient decrease 1e-4, lambda = 1, 1/2,..., 1/64); a continuation in the viscosity (or Re) is allowed: whatever path is used, the solution is that of the steady discrete equations
nonlinear_solver.history: solver.history = [{kind, residual, step}] with the relative residual after each step

parameters.dirichlet_data: P1 nodal interpolation of the fixed callables at the boundary vertices

patch.f: from the strong equations: rho (u_t + (u.grad)u) + grad p - div sigma_visc (quadratic polynomial, integrated exactly by the pinned rule); f5_gls_check.Patch is the reference implementation
patch.representability: u and p are P1 functions: the discrete solution must equal the exact one to round-off on every mesh, for Stokes, Oseen (w = exact u) and Navier-Stokes, steady, and transient (BDF1 and BDF2, u linear in t so the discrete time derivative is exact; exact history)

graded.construction: f5_gls_check.graded_mesh(8, 8, 100.0): 8 x 8 cells, geometric row heights with ratio 100 (aspect up to ~800), corner cells flipped

transient.history: the exact nodal values at t_{n-1}, t_{n-2}
